propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, maerentium consolator et in te sperantium salus, qui beatae Monicae
pias lacrimas in conversione filii sui Augustini misericorditer suscepisti:
da nobis utriusque interventu; peccata nostra deplorare, et gratiae tuae
indulgentiam invenire. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:

Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, the consoler of them that mourn and the health of them that hope in Thee, Who didst show Thine acceptance of blessed Monica's pious tears in the conversion of her son Augustine, grant us, by the intercession of them both, to deplore our sins and find the mercy of Thy grace. Through our Lord.

Per Dominum.
